description: This file defines the TransactionTestRunnerBase class, which provides methods for creating and managing test grains in an Orleans transaction testing context. It includes methods for generating random test grains, testing grains with specific identifiers, and retrieving grain instances via a grain factory.

classes.name: TransactionTestRunnerBase
classes.description: Base class for running transaction tests with Orleans grains, providing utility methods for grain instantiation and management.

methods.name: TransactionTestRunnerBase
methods.description: Constructor initializing the grain factory and test output delegate.

methods.name: RandomTestGrain
methods.description: Creates a random test grain implementing ITransactionTestGrain based on class names.

methods.name: RandomTestGrain<TGrainInterface>
methods.description: Generic method to create a random test grain of specified interface type.

methods.name: TestGrain
methods.description: Creates a test grain with a specific class name and GUID.

methods.name: TestGrain<TGrainInterface>
methods.description: Creates a test grain of specified interface type with a given class name and GUID.
